hypothesis.statement: Persistently low or negative BTC perpetual funding marks washed-out positioning and precedes upward drift; persistently high funding marks crowded longs and precedes weakness.
hypothesis.expected_sign: positive mean return when funding is in its bottom trailing tercile; negative when in the top tercile
hypothesis.mechanism_detail: Funding is the price longs pay shorts to hold a perpetual. It is a direct, continuously-quoted observable of crowding. Extremes in the trailing distribution mark positioning washouts and crowding respectively; the signal is contrarian on the level, not on its change.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: The trailing tercile rank of daily mean funding has no predictive power for the sign of the next day's BTC return.
hypothesis.known_caveats_at_registration: Bull-regime Sharpe -0.36 (mean-reverts poorly in sustained bull); sideways-regime Sharpe 2.21 (concentrated). Full-sample Sharpe 0.2307 and train-slice 0.2230 both sit below the 0.30 candidate.edge floor, which is why the role is feature, not edge. |r| = 0.8187 against g6_funding_basis_composite is a declared independence risk (see evidence_basis).
hypothesis.role_note: Feature role: standalone train Sharpe 0.2230 < 0.30 edge floor. Registered as a conditioning/explanatory input. Gate 6A.8-PRE measured its filter value: gating a collecting signal by agreement with it raised risk-adjusted return on 3 of 5 and reduced max drawdown on 5 of 5, at a large exposure cost. Nothing in this registration is a standalone-edge claim.

function_spec.name: Funding Level (contrarian)
function_spec.data_source: Binance USDT-perp (binanceusdm BTC/USDT:USDT) daily mean funding rate x 10000 (bps), 8-hourly prints aggregated per UTC day, days with fewer than 2 prints dropped
function_spec.entry_condition_long: funding_bps < rolling 33rd percentile over RW=252 days (min_periods=126)
function_spec.entry_condition_short: funding_bps > rolling 67th percentile over RW=252 days (min_periods=126)
function_spec.flat_condition: funding between the terciles, OR funding/quantile NaN (insufficient history)
function_spec.hold_days_note: The battery evaluated this signal at hold_days=1 (continuous daily re-evaluation). Forward collection uses hold_days=7 to reduce turnover, matching every other collecting signal. IS and forward Sharpe distributions are not directly comparable across the two conventions.
function_spec.exit_rule: scheduled exit at entry + 7 calendar days; signal re-evaluated at exit for re-entry. No intra-hold exits.
function_spec.trade_counting_definition: each 7-day evaluation window is one trade; trades are sequential and non-overlapping
function_spec.sensitivity_note: Battery sens_pass_frac = 0.75 (3 of 4 variants sign-stable), above the 0.60 feature floor. No sweep was run for this registration; the parameter set is the one the battery evaluated.

evidence_basis.corpus: Binance BTCUSDT spot 1m resampled to daily + Binance USDT-perp funding, 2021-01-01..2026-05-31
evidence_basis.train_slice_note: Measured 2026-08-26 at Gate 6A.8-PRE on the train slice only, hold_days=1, cost 15 bps: Sharpe 0.2230, max_dd 66.08%, 209 trades, 902 active days of 1612 (56.0%).
evidence_basis.full_sample_sharpe_note: The pinned battery run records full-sample Sharpe 0.2307 over 2021-01-01..2026-05-31, a window that SPANS the sealed lockbox. It is recorded for transparency and is NOT the gating number; the train-slice 0.2230 is. Both fail the 0.30 edge floor, so the role classification does not depend on which is used.
evidence_basis.dsr_prob_note: NOT COMPUTED. No DSR was recorded for this family by the Phase B battery, and none is fabricated here. Under R1 (CLAUDE.md section 16) a NULL governance stat is a hard failure at the Validated gate, which is the correct and intended consequence: g2 cannot reach Validated until DSR is computed via compute_dsr_for_registration.py at the FROZEN n_trials=34. This does not block candidate-state forward collection.
evidence_basis.bh_p_note: NOT COMPUTED, same basis and same consequence as dsr_prob.
evidence_basis.independence_note: Measured at Gate 6A.8-PRE on the train slice with the analyze_mtf_independence convention (position-series Pearson, _arr alignment, both-std>0 guard). Against the five signals actually collecting the max is 0.3774 (g3_momentum_tsmom), and every correlation is negative - a contrarian positioning signal running against a trend-heavy book; VIF R^2-on-others = 0.225. Against all existing registered families the max is 0.8187 (g6_funding_basis_composite), which EXCEEDS max_pairwise_r = 0.70. See notable_flags.
evidence_basis.candidate_gate_result: PASS Feature gate: sens_pass_frac 0.75 >= 0.60, OOS Sharpe +0.11 > 0, clone_r 0.8187 < 0.90. FAIL Edge gate (train Sharpe 0.2230 < 0.30). Registered as feature, not edge.
notable_flags: DECLARED INDEPENDENCE RISK, NOT RESOLVED: |r| = 0.8187 against g6_funding_basis_composite exceeds max_pairwise_r = 0.70. That family is currently `discovery` and is not collecting, so the conflict is latent rather than active - but if it is ever promoted, the Validated independence gate will fire on this pair. Recorded at registration so the outcome is foreseeable, not a surprise at promotion.
This signal is NOT independent of its own funding/positioning family. It IS independent of everything currently collecting (max 0.3774).
DSR and BH-p are NULL by design, not by omission. Validated is unreachable until both are computed at n_trials=34.
Feature role only. Standalone Sharpe fails the edge floor on both the train slice and the full sample.
Funding ingest is CRITICAL in daily_ingest.py (step 3 of 4), unlike DVOL. A funding outage makes g2 'unavailable' (transient skip), never a silent flat, and must never block H5/G1/G3/IVRV.

observation_floors.rationale: Feature-role, low per-trade Sharpe. Train activity is 56.0% of days and 17.7 trades/yr at hold_days=7, so n=30 is roughly 1.7 years; 12 months minimum before assessment to span vol regimes. Both low-funding (long) and high-funding (short) trades must be observed - train split was 582 long / 320 short days.

promotion_criteria.description: Criteria to consider g2_funding_level for Validated. All must hold simultaneously, evaluated only after the observation floors are met.

gates.G1_direction: mean forward trade return > 0 net of 15 bps
gates.G2_governance_stats: dsr_prob >= 0.50 AND bh_p <= 0.10, computed at the FROZEN n_trials=34 on forward returns
gates.G3_independence: max_pairwise_r <= 0.70 against every Validated family at the time of promotion - see the declared 0.8187 risk
gates.G4_role: promotion is to feature role; an edge claim would require a separate registration

promotion_criteria.notes: n=30 is underpowered for a low per-trade Sharpe. Failure to reject H0 must be recorded as 'insufficient evidence', never as 'disproven'.

daily_job.trigger: once per day at 01:00 UTC, after forward_evidence/daily_ingest.py has refreshed the funding partition
data_inputs: Binance USDT-perp daily mean funding bps, via runner_base.load_daily_funding()
steps: 1. Load funding history through run_date (MIN_HISTORY rows minimum)
3. compute_signal(funding) -> position series; take the run_date value
4. Write signal_log, run_log, and trade rows via runner_base.run_signal()
daily_job.isolation: A funding load failure raises DataUnavailableError and marks g2 'unavailable' for that run only. It must never block or alter h5_vol_regime, g1_market_regime_sma200, g3_momentum_tsmom, g3_atr_expansion or ivrv_vrp_spread.

content: DSR on non-overlapping 7-day forward trade returns (compute when n >= 30)

The DSR minimum n >= 30 is a governance criterion DISTINCT from the observation floor minimum_trades = 30. The two coincide numerically for this family and are NOT conflated: the observation floor governs admissibility, the DSR minimum governs when DSR/BH may be computed. FR-5's three minima remain separate, and n >= 5 stays the mathematical computability guard which never establishes sufficiency. Adopted at FB-10b-O (FDB-8 Option A, human-authorized).

lockbox_status.notes: Not spent by this signal. All gating numbers in evidence_basis are train-slice (2021-01-01..2025-05-31). The pinned battery run's full-sample Sharpe spans the lockbox and is recorded for transparency only, never used for gating. The lockbox remains the final pre-promotion OOS test.

notes: Do not modify decision_function_g2_funding_level.py after this registration.
Any parameter change requires a VERSION bump and a new pre-registration.
fn_hash in run_log must match function_spec.decision_function_hash every run.

The decision function is a faithful port of evidence/signals.py sig_funding_level(pctile=33, rw=252), proven value-identical on the real corpus (2038/2038 rows, elementwise equal, max abs difference 0.0). The battery function is NOT imported at runtime, per the g3_tsmom and ivrv precedent.
This registration does not change g2's registry state (candidate) or role (feature), and grants no execution or live-trading path.
